notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
description:
Cast Airbender's Reversal by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying its mana cost reduced by Hamza.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Airbender's Reversal targeting Lutri.
Resolve Airbender's Reversal, airbending Lutri.
Holding priority, cast Lutri from exile by paying {0} due to Hamza.
Repeat from step 3.
